$example.//: Reference only — not a real program. Every option, with its default. Copy the keys you need under a program folder name in Docs/ and delete this block.

options.enabled: true (default) puts the program on /workshops; false hides just its card — the guides stay published and can still be opened by URL.
options.published: true (default) keeps the guides reachable; false unpublishes the whole folder — no card, no nav or prev/next entries, and the URLs are not generated, so they 404.
options.startAt: Title of the doc inside the program that the card opens. Default: the program's first guide. An unknown title falls back to that first guide.
options.href: Full URL for the card to point at instead, e.g. an off-site page. Wins over startAt. Default: the program's first guide.
